[quote=tallisland;60697308][b]Late Registration[/b]

In light of the immense loss of life during the Karwbridc Naval Office assault, both Kjersti Stennes and Holy President Clifford Prisk (under pressure from the Vice President and Prime Minister) have agreed to open up negotiations for an end to the conflict. The Principalist government opted to send High War-Priest Wojciech Saebaldr to represent the interests of Tallisland, especially pertaining to the loss of life of Tallislandic soldiers, whereas the Anti-Principalists have chosen Michał Grabarczyk to represent them.

Patriarch Błoński refused to comment on the situation, though Prime Minister Elwira Piekarz agreed to speak on the behalf of the Patriarch and Holy President. "God is the most truly hurt by gruesome conflicts such as these, faithful fighting faithful, so it is the duty of all true Lusandrics to champion peace so that we may all pray for redemption as one." 

No Anti-Principalist figure was able to comment on the peace negotiations, though reacts among their supporters online appear to be mixed.

[quote=lavinsworth_united_islands;60644308]Perfect. Ill let my colleagues take up their concerns then.

David Witstrom stood up, looking out over the vineyard. He seemed tired in a way. Maybe it was the wine, maybe it was the trip earlier in the day, but nevertheless he turned to Klos. I know your nation wants to purchase some ships from us. We can do that. Doesnt matter what you need apart from an aircraft carrier, it wont be much of a deal to get them to you. 

He would pause before rubbing his temples to continue. Some of my advisors wish for you to influence future arms purchases your military makes. We have exported some rifles to your nation before the whole revolution, and they wish to keep that a trend.[/quote]

"Ah, yes, the ships! 

Here I have the request that the Department of Defense asked me to deliver."

He looks at one of his folders 

"The Department of Defense wanted to acquire at least 2 amphibious assault ships, 3 destroyers, a frigate, and a cruiser. from you. As well as at least 1 underway replenishment ship for both surface and submarine ships."

He then moves to address the second request

"I think I can do that, given my new position that I will be inaugurated into upon my return to the country. 

Your country is a reliable partner of ours. And typically, your equipment is higher quality than our own domestically produced equipment. As long as you can keep providing that, I don't see why a partnership couldn't be established. Although maybe we could negotiate a discount of sorts? Lower prices in return for greater favor?"
